node.title: Registro previo a admisión y promoción posterior
node.summary: Preserve an authorised trace before its classification for possible later admission.

relations: Event-triggered promotion can be compared retrospectively with relabeling cascades, provided event identity and the times of capture, knowledge and reinterpretation remain distinct.
La comparación no atribuye al código histórico el operador formal SA-CR de octubre de 2026.
Operational tracking could retain permitted unresolved traces before lossy admission, so that later qualification can revisit evidence that actually exists.
No se propone retención indiscriminada; fuente, propósito, privacidad y plazo siguen limitando lo que puede guardarse.
The dual-time contract makes a later implementation obligation explicit: historical reinterpretation and current permission to rely on a certificate must be evaluated separately.
El contrato permanece en PR60 y requiere infraestructura independiente de firmas, reloj, derechos y estado de revocación.
